patches_added.name: AMOLED - App menu
patches_added.description: Restores native AppMenu resources and three verified bytecode injections.

patches_added.name: AMOLED - Context menu
patches_added.description: Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White to the verified Cromite context-menu content surface while preserving the transparent outer dialog window.

patches_added.name: AMOLED - New Tab Page (tile resources)
patches_added.description: Recovers original NTP tile icon background resources; NewTabPageLayout and Most Visited DEX changes remain pending.

patches_added.name: AMOLED - Omnibox and search UI
patches_added.description: Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White to verified LocationBarTablet background setters without adding control-flow branches.

patches_added.name: AMOLED - Settings
patches_added.description: Recovers SettingsActivity, preference backgrounds, and the original containment-card color override.

patches_added.name: AMOLED - Tabs and tab strip
patches_added.description: Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White directly to verified Cromite TabGridView and TabGridDialogView backgrounds.

patches_added.name: AMOLED - Toolbar
patches_added.description: Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White directly to the verified Cromite ToolbarTablet background setter.

patches_added.name: Cromite DevTools: native COPY button (experimental)
patches_added.description: Embed verified DevTools frontend and bootstrap for Cromite 153; runtime behavior unverified.

patches_added.name: Hide status bar in Settings
patches_added.description: Independent Cromite Settings patch. Hides the Android status bar only in SettingsActivity and does not modify the working main-browser status-bar patch.

patches_added.name: Hide layout components
patches_added.description: Adds settings to hide the Subscription and Report a problem sidebar entries.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks offline maps, real-time traffic and weather, elevation maps, activity recording, vehicle profiles, personalized voices and Android Auto.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Blocks usage statistics sent to imo, AppsFlyer, Firebase and Facebook, and the advertising ID upload.

patches_modified.name: Disable update check
patches_modified.description: Removes the forced update screen and the update prompts.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Voice Club tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Voice Club tab from the home screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes splash, chat list, story and end-of-call ads, and skips the ad consent form.

patches_modified.name: Hide invite prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides the invite friends dialog, the invite entry in the chat list and the call sharing banner.

patches_modified.name: Prevent screenshot detection
patches_modified.description: Stops chats and calls from reporting screenshots and screen recordings to the other person.

patches_modified.name: Raise media sending limit
patches_modified.description: Raises the limit on photos, videos and files sent at once to 100.

patches_modified.name: Remove chat protection
patches_modified.description: Allows copying, sharing, forwarding and downloading messages protected by the sender's chat privacy settings or Time Machine.

patches_modified.name: Remove contact selection limit
patches_modified.description: Raises the limit on contacts selected for iBubble close friends and Family Guard invites to 999. Experimental.

patches_modified.name: Remove forwarding restrictions
patches_modified.description: Allows forwarding disappearing and view-once text messages.

patches_modified.name: Remove screenshot restriction
patches_modified.description: Allows screenshots and screen recording in chats, calls, media and profiles.

patches_modified.name: Remove story video limit
patches_modified.description: Removes the length limit on story videos picked from the gallery or recorded.

patches_modified.name: Show full profile photos
patches_modified.description: Opens profile photos in full size when their owner restricts it.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Restores phone verification by call when signing in.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks imo Premium.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes ads before and during videos. Live TV is unavailable from outside Joyn's supported countries.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes ads before and during videos. Live TV requires a German IP address.

patches_added.name: Hide layout components
patches_added.description: Adds settings to hide the Spread the word section, the Discover Proton section and the Proton Pass banner.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, or dates on profile grids. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Always upload in HD
patches_modified.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_modified.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Block contact list access
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_modified.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment send fix
patches_modified.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_modified.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the app language
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Look like the store app
patches_modified.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Hushfeed's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_modified.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_modified.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Profile background
patches_modified.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Story controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, or dates on profile grids. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Always upload in HD
patches_modified.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_modified.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Block contact list access
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_modified.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment send fix
patches_modified.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_modified.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_modified.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches_modified.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_modified.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_modified.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_modified.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the app language
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Look like the store app
patches_modified.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Hushfeed's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_modified.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_modified.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Profile background
patches_modified.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Story controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
